_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. F001 and F003 were restored 2026-08-19 after a data-corruption bug (commit 8d6979a accidentally overwrote their ids to 'FE001'/'FE003' while adding the real Landing-page/VerifyEmail-page entries, destroying the originals and creating duplicate ids). Restored from the last known-good commit (6fc366f) and re-verified independently on a fresh clone rather than trusted at face value - see Decisions.md for the full incident note and the process change adopted to prevent recurrence.

Restored from pre-corruption commit 6fc366f. Re-verified independently on a fresh clone of main (b00fb30): pytest tests/test_nodes.py -x -> passed as part of the 92-test fast suite.

features.name: Configurable embedding provider + offline/no-network fallback
features.behavior: get_embedder() (src/braintodo/api/nodes.py) reads settings.embedding_provider ('sentence_transformer' default | 'fake'). SentenceTransformerProvider wraps model-load OSError in a clear, actionable RuntimeError instead of a raw huggingface.co connection stack trace. Fixes a real gap: production always hardcoded the real SentenceTransformerProvider with no fallback, but every existing test overrode get_embedder with FakeEmbeddingProvider, so this path had never been exercised by any test in any session - a network-restricted deploy would 500 on every POST /nodes despite a fully green suite.
features.evidence: Discovered 2026-08-24: after installing torch/torch-geometric/sentence-transformers for the first time in any session and running the FULL suite (not the fast/excluded suite), confirmed get_sentence_transformer_provider() raises a raw OSError connecting to huggingface.co in this network-restricted sandbox - i.e. F001 (Node CRUD) would 500 on every create in an offline deploy despite being marked passing. Fixed via EMBEDDING_PROVIDER setting + FakeEmbeddingProvider fallback + clear RuntimeError. Verified both directions: (1) default 'sentence_transformer' with no network reachable raises RuntimeError with actionable message (was raw OSError before fix); (2) EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=fake exercised through the REAL api.nodes.get_embedder -> NodeRepository dependency-injection path (not a test override) successfully returns 201 on POST /nodes with a real embedding vector. pytest tests/test_embedding_provider_config.py -> 5/5 passed. Full suite re-run after fix: 118 passed, 1 skipped (test_neo4j_store.py self-skips, no live Neo4j in this sandbox), ruff check . clean, mypy src tests clean.
